name: Cyberwizards
summary: Cairns and Far North Queensland ISP (cyberwizards.com.au, site maintained by Scott Blackman). The Age (13 Mar 2003): 'Cyberwizards services the Cairns and North Queensland market'. Acquired by Chariot Ltd in its March 2003 four-ISP purchase (with Mr Bean, Better.Net and eCITE).

events.details: Existing as an ISP by 28 Nov 1999: cyberwizards.com.au captured by the Wayback Machine — a full portal ('©1999 CYBERWIZARDS, published and maintained by Scott Blackman') with FNQ-focused links (Far North Queensland Emergency Service, Crystal Caves Atherton), finance, government and shopping sections. Served the Cairns and Far North Queensland market.

Acquired by Chariot Limited among four ISPs announced 12 Mar 2003: 'Cyberwizards services the Cairns and North Queensland market' (The Age/SMH, 12-13 Mar 2003), with Mr Bean (Mackay), Better.Net (Murwillumbah) and eCITE (Adelaide). Part of Chariot's consolidation ahead of its 150,000-customer target.
